race.comment: RAVIN' AVA (7) is the one to beat after putting a space on them in a Mdn over 1230m at this track, beating Tasman Jewel on that occasion. The move to 1500m doesn't look an issue and she has plenty of upside. Can repeat the dose. BONDI EXPRESS (2) has the right foundation after a first-up second in BM58+ company here, where he was bumped near the 500m yet kept working, and his track-and-trip win gives him strong appeal despite the wide draw. JELLYBEAN JONES (1) was better last start in NMW grade when fifth and beaten two and a half lengths, and his track record keeps him firmly in calculations, though the 1500m record and top weight are genuine queries. GREAT DEAL (9) has been fourth at both runs back, is proven at this track and distance, and has enough third-up improvement to press for a placing if he finishes off more sharply. SHOOT TO FAME (6) is racing in good order and can't be discounted.
